name: Hindsight
description: Hindsight is an open-source memory server for AI agents. Agents retain conversations and documents into memory banks, then recall facts, entities and their history, or reflect on them, through a REST API, SDKs and an MCP server.

app_vars.name: var_llm_provider
app_vars.label: LLM Provider
app_vars.help: Empty for none: memories are stored as plain chunks, without fact extraction or reflect. Otherwise openai, anthropic, gemini, groq, ollama, lmstudio and others; see https://hindsight.vectorize.io/developer/models

app_vars.name: var_llm_api_key
app_vars.label: LLM API Key
app_vars.help: Not needed for ollama or lmstudio

app_vars.name: var_llm_model
app_vars.label: LLM Model
app_vars.help: Empty for the provider's default model

app_vars.name: var_llm_base_url
app_vars.label: LLM Base URL
app_vars.help: Empty for the provider's default. For a local LLM, e.g. the Ollama script's container: http://<ollama-ip>:11434/v1

notes.text: The API key is saved to `~/hindsight.creds` inside the container. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` to the API and the MCP endpoint.
Without an LLM, Hindsight stores plain chunks only. Set the provider, key and model in `/opt/hindsight.env`, then run `systemctl restart hindsight`.
